request.prompt: [Subject & Action] A precise editorial still life about collecting public product review data: three floating ivory review cards with abstract horizontal line marks and small star symbols, connected by thin luminous threads to one transparent structured data archive cube. Represents Amazon US written review collection and traceable JSONL records, not review optimization. [Style & Aesthetics] Premium minimalist ecommerce data illustration, photorealistic 3D render, frosted glass, matte porcelain, crisp geometric detail, tasteful amber accents and slate blue. [Lighting & Atmosphere] Soft studio daylight from the upper left, subtle cool rim lighting, realistic gentle shadows, calm trustworthy atmosphere. [Composition & Constraints] Widescreen 16:9 safe central composition within a 1536x1024 image intended for a centered 1536x864 crop. Keep every important object inside the central 84 percent height. Single focused theme, generous negative space, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no Amazon logo, no user faces, no real review screenshots, no rising rating arrows, no watermark, no official endorsement.
